novelty_boundary.new_mechanism: single environmental contact stores and returns normal deformation energy while topology stays closed; root velocity reverses before release, and release is authored only after a zero-load touching state

rig.force_axis: wall normal points away from +X wall; body approach is +X, stored-energy return is -X

keys.name: READY_SEPARATE
keys.causal_role: readable before-state with approach room and no wall relationship
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root has forward room; wall contact is not yet eligible.

keys.name: APPROACH_ASYMMETRIC
keys.causal_role: body-first approach with rear leg driving before the arm can touch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis and chest advance before the distal hand reaches the wall.

keys.name: PRECONTACT_ELIGIBLE_GAP
keys.causal_role: one-cell visible gap establishes eligibility before acquisition
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Leading hand is adjacent but separated by a blank cell; topology remains open.

keys.name: TOUCH_ZERO_LOAD
keys.causal_role: authored acquisition overlap without yet inventing wall load
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Hand touches the wall at a fixed point while normal load is still zero.

keys.name: COMPRESSION_LOAD_ONSET
keys.causal_role: normal load begins only after contact; root continues into body compression
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Fixed distal wall point resists continued approach; pelvis drops and advances while torso shortens.

keys.name: COMPRESSION_LOAD_MAX
keys.causal_role: maximum stored compression under unchanged topology; strongest wall-normal load
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Fixed wall hand and planted feet cage the body into a visibly shortened head-neck-pelvis stack; stored normal deformation peaks before recoil.

keys.name: ENERGY_RETURN_CONTACT_HELD
keys.causal_role: stored energy reverses root motion while wall contact remains closed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis has reversed away from wall, but head/shoulder lag remains wallward and the hand stays fixed.

keys.name: UNLOAD_TOUCH_ZERO
keys.causal_role: wall load returns to zero while contact topology still remains closed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body has substantially decompressed; hand still touches without force, proving load and topology are separate.

keys.name: AUTHORED_RELEASE_GAP
keys.causal_role: real topology change occurs only after zero-load touch; a visible gap opens
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Hand withdraws two cells from the wall; contact opens after unloading rather than causing unloading.

keys.name: RECOIL_OVERRUN_REAR_CATCH
keys.causal_role: root continues away after release while distal arm and head lag toward former contact
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear foot catches the recoil while the wall-side arm remains visibly late.

keys.name: COUNTER_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: torso crosses past rest after the rear-foot catch; recovery is not reverse interpolation
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis recenters before head/shoulder; upper body counter-overshoots away from the former contact.

keys.name: READY_DISPLACED_DEBT
keys.causal_role: action-capable new address with unequal arm/stance debt preserved
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Final stance is displaced and asymmetric; it does not snap back to the initial idle.

compile.method: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS -> EXPLICIT HOLDS/TIMING -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> H.264 MP4 -> SPA
compile.connective_motion: NONE BETWEEN SEMANTIC CONTACT/LOAD KEYS; decisive authored states and explicit holds only.
compile.deterministic_ffmpeg: libx264 threads=1 yuv420p crf=42 bitexact faststart

rounds.defect: LOAD_MAX read too much like a generic forward crouch/push; the fixed wall point was clear, but the body did not visibly bank enough deformation to make stored compliant energy the primary read.
rounds.correction: On SAME C021-K5, keep the wall hand and planted feet fixed while shortening the head-neck-pelvis stack, packing shoulders toward the contact, and moving COM into the compressed cage; preserve later root reversal under closed contact.

rounds.reason: Actual revised decisive-frame sheet visibly earns gap→touch-zero→loaded compression, keeps the wall hand fixed through maximum deformation and root reversal, unloads to zero while still touching, opens a real release gap only afterward, then carries wall-side arm/head lag into rear-foot catch, counter-overshoot, and a displaced asymmetric restack. No custody, support teleport, reverse playback, endpoint-only contact, or generic bridge.

noodle_queen.taste: The LOAD_MAX silhouette folds into a compact spring against the wall, then the pelvis escapes before the wall-side head and arm; the relationship has a memorable before/packed/return shape rather than mannequin contact.
noodle_queen.function: Topology and load visibly diverge: zero-load touch precedes force, the fixed contact survives compression and root reversal, zero-load touch returns before release, and the actual gap is authored after unloading.
noodle_queen.contempt: No generic wall shove, custody promotion, straight tween bridge, metadata-only spring, release-before-unload, idle reset, or copied source silhouette.
